# Reference Evidence Package — Harbor Tours

## Package identity and scope

- Schema version: 2. Package HT-FORWARD-r1, 2026-10-04; UTC inspection timestamps, project timezone Africa/Cairo.
- Contract: [fidelity-scope-contract.md](fidelity-scope-contract.md), FC-HT-01/r1; [task authority](authority.md). Evidence-only static inspection and handoff; stop before implementation.
- Designated source: supplied.html, app.js and app.js.map from ../forward-inputs. Their byte set is authoritative; historical public URL, capture date/conditions and deployed equivalence are unknown.
- Exact later scope: page appearance/layout, responsive menu and canvas behavior in desktop/mobile Chromium; preserve booking host section. Provider interior may become a contact link. Future content may change.
- No raw-source execution, browser loading, live access, endpoint replay, submissions, purchases or messages. No implementation or target acceptance was performed.
- New isolated forward-test output; supplied copies byte-identical. Skill, raw inputs, frozen Haunted Boulder City evidence, configuration and websites untouched.
- Operator: forward-validation agent. Ordinary local write verified independently from browser save root; no browser save attempted. Tool metadata discovered DevTools/Polypane, but no session enumerated or used under static-only boundary.
- Evidence-only packet complete; reconstruction clearance NO; adaptation clearance NO. Integrity does not establish fidelity or permission to reuse.
